_comment: Bonus material hub, one per title. Printed/spoken URL is /books/<isbn>/bonus/chapters.html and never changes. Edit this file, then run: python3 tools/build-bonus.py

9781922263988.name: The Art of Surrender
9781922263988.author: Blair Purvis
intro: There is more of this story than fits between the covers.
Some of it happens before the novel starts. Some of it happens in the rooms the novel walks past. It gets written here, and you get a say in what gets written next.

ballot.heading: What gets written next
ballot.blurb: Eight chapters could come before the novel begins. Four belong to Lucas, four to Ayman. Only one of them is going to be written. Pick the one you want and I will write it.

options.title: The Crop
options.pitch: Lucas at eighteen: a mountain, pack horses and a superior officer. Lessons in discipline.

options.title: The Regatta
options.pitch: A school trip, 2011. Lucas is fourteen, and someone takes the photograph of happiness that will hang on his wall.

options.title: Sochi
options.pitch: Lucas is seventeen. Yasmin makes the Olympic team and Lucas doesn't. A friendship under the hardest test.

options.title: Can the Cannes
options.pitch: Lazarus, Judy and the Phoenix at Cannes. By the end of the week Judy is ready to throw him overboard.

options.title: The Lost Brother
options.pitch: Beirut, 1979. Two half-brothers, two faiths, and a war that split them.

options.title: I'll Cut Your Throat and Cook Rice in It
options.pitch: Beirut. Two boys, a summer with a grandmother who frightens them, and the one thing she says that they'll never forget.

options.title: Rugby Scrums at the Rock
options.pitch: Gibraltar. A girlfriend called Zoe, a rugby changing room, and a feeling Ayman can't yet name.

options.title: Serrano Spies in the Saliba Shop
options.pitch: Two boys minding the family shop decide the stranger at the counter is a spy from Serrano Marine. Is he?

form._comment: Hand-built form posting to the Zoho Campaigns author-list signup form. vote_field is the Campaigns custom field's form name; set it once the field exists. Until then the form is inert.
